short_description: A cool monster decal for octane, that's all I can say about it? I recommend using Lime/Black Octane on this decal, including black diecis. There are reactive parts which will be glowing the colour...
long_description:
A cool monster decal for octane, that's all I can say about it?
I recommend using Lime/Black Octane on this decal, including black diecis.
There are reactive parts which will be glowing the colour of your boost, so I recommend using any lime boost too!
Reason why I recommend using black diecis is because you can see the neon green glowing part there when you drive, yes you can see it if you use other wheels too but it's not as flashy.
Hope you enjoy it and I wish you a great rest of your day & night!
